DIRECTIVE (EU) 2099/3 OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL

of 2 February 2099

on sustainability reporting by fixture undertakings

THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND THE COUNCIL OF THE EUROPEAN UNION,

Having regard to the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, and in particular Articles 50 and 114 thereof,

Whereas:

(1)

The first recital of the flat fixture explains why sustainability information must be reliable and comparable across the Union.

(2)

The second recital of the flat fixture explains that reporting requirements should be proportionate for medium-sized undertakings.

HAVE ADOPTED THIS DIRECTIVE:

CHAPTER I

SCOPE AND DEFINITIONS

Article 1

Scope

1. This Directive applies to large undertakings and to parent undertakings of large groups.

2. Member States may extend the scope of this Directive to medium-sized undertakings.

Article 2

Definitions

For the purposes of this Directive, the following definitions apply:

(1)

‘large undertaking’ means an undertaking exceeding the thresholds laid down in Article 3;

(2)

‘net turnover’ means the amounts derived from the sale of products and the provision of services.

Done at Strasbourg, 2 February 2099.

For the European Parliament
